<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Friendly Nudge](/Feats.aspx?ID=5364) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Minotaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=788" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 43

**Prerequisites**
Trained in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36)

</column>

---

You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself. Attempt an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) check to [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=2380) an ally. You don't need to have a free hand to attempt this check. If your ally is willing, treat the result as one degree of success higher.

<title level="2">Friendly Nudge leads to...</title>
[Shift the Little Ones](/Feats.aspx?ID=5380)
name: Friendly Nudge
